rules.bucket: UTC day D by block timestamp, [D 00:00, D+1 00:00)
rules.btc_closure: MTP of the block with 6 confirmations >= D+1 00:00
rules.eth_pow_closure: a block stamped >= D+1 00:00 is 64 deep
rules.compute_not_before: D+1 06:00 UTC, and only if every required chain closed day D by then
rules.execution: D+1 12:00 UTC; if the signal is not usable, hold the previous position

btc_closure_delay_minutes_model.note: Erlang(11) model under exponential block arrivals; not an empirical measurement
